statement:
∀ (F f : ℝ → ℝ),
  Continuous F →
    Continuous f →
      (∀ (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ F t) →
        ∀ (M : ℝ),
          (∀ (y : ℝ), |f y| ≤ M) →
            ∀ (x : ℝ), ∫ (y : ℝ) in -π..π, F (x - y) = 2 * π → |1 / (2 * π) * ∫ (y : ℝ) in -π..π, F (x - y) * f y| ≤ M

integrals.function: fun y => F (x - y) * f y
